CAMEL-21944.title: camel-jbang - Classpath scan custom JARs for beans and processors with dependency injection annotations
CAMEL-21944.description:
You may have a custom JAR that contains some SB/Quarkus beans that have annotated with @Component @Named or whatever annotations these runtimes uses for this stuff.

So if the JAR has a class that is annotated with @Named("cheese") then we can try to find this class and know the classname and this can help jbang to run the code and also able to export as well.

This is for existing pre build JARs (if you have custom java code then jbang detect these among the custom java source files)
